label: AI industry & leadership
angle: Company decisions, leadership debates, partnerships, competition, funding, and meaningful changes in the AI industry.

label: AI policy & safety
angle: Regulation, safety commitments, privacy, copyright, and governance. Distinguish proposals from rules already in force.

label: Work, society & education
angle: How technology changes jobs, learning, creativity, and daily life. Separate research findings from speculation.

label: Consumer AI & products
angle: Useful apps, devices, search, accessibility, and product changes that people can actually use.

label: Science & AI research
angle: Interesting papers and scientific applications beyond LLM launches. Explain limitations and label preprints.

label: Cloud, security & developer tools
angle: Infrastructure, software incidents, cybersecurity, open source, and practical developer tools.

label: AI model releases
angle: Major model releases only when they have a meaningful, verified consequence for users.

label: Japan life & practical hacks
angle: Japan daily life, transport, useful services, housing routines, culture, and practical life hacks for residents and visitors. Prefer a verified recent service change or local announcement with a useful guide. Use Japanese primary sources and explain who and which location the advice applies to. Do not turn this into an AI or coding story.
